closing.summary: Big strengths are magnesium, omega 3, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low protein quality, and low starch. It is good for bone health, blood and oxygen support, and heart health because calcium and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, and fibre supports the heart-health side.
